newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen's Jan/June 97 oil export income $464.6 mln.
newsitem.headline: Yemen's Jan/June 97 oil export income $464.6 mln.

text.p: Yemen's first half 1997 oil export income was $464.6 million, compared with full-year 1996 oil export income of $958.4 million, an oil ministry statement said.
It said the government's share of crude produced in Yemen in the first six months stood at 40.98 million barrels.
Local consumption for the same period stood at 16.32 million barrels, while the government's share of exports hovered around 24.66 million barrels.
The government's share of crude produced in Yemen in 1996 reached 28.76 million barrels for local consumption, while its share for export stood at 47.03 million barrels.
